verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions generating documentation for a repository, or querying such documentation for public or private repos. Git integrations and side-question features (openhands-docs-18) are adjacent agent capabilities, not a generated-docs query feature, so they earn no credit. The axis is a fair one for a repo-integrated coding agent, so the verdict is none rather than na.
